<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the red lipstick is the focus of the first action.

detailed_description:
The video presents a cinematic, realistic lifestyle aesthetic set in a minimalist hallway with neutral cream walls and soft natural lighting. The action is quick, deliberate, and stylish.
[Shot 1] The frame begins as a static shot from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> stands centered, holding <Subject 2> in her right hand at chest level. Her gaze is steady forward through her sunglasses.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a smooth tracking shot that trucks right with medium amplitude at a moderate speed. <Subject 1> performs a crisp, rhythmic "snap" motion with <Subject 2>, followed immediately by her lowering the lipstick into the white tote bag hanging on her left shoulder. Her head shifts slightly as she adjusts the bag.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a smooth tracking shot that trucks left with small amplitude at a slow speed. <Subject 1> pivots sharply and walks a few steps back toward the white ledge. She reaches out and picks up <Subject 3> from the shelf with a snappy motion, ending in a confident, poised stance holding her phone.

overall_soundscape:
The soundscape is minimalist and rhythmic, focusing on the sharp "snap" of the lipstick case, the soft rustle of the canvas tote, and the crisp "clack" of heels on the floor. A distinct electronic vibration is heard in the final shot. No dialogue or background music is present.
